ditrih_88: The new rifleman gave his name as Marek Ditrih. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
First Wave. Marek Ditrih signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.

Dorian Austintress lent Marek Ditrih a pencil. The returned pencil came wrapped in a scrap of paper marked 'One good turn'. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Marek Ditrih looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
jiri.satalik: Bram Satalik took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Bram Satalik was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Bram Satalik put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Bram Satalik during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
yurboixav: Wendel Yurboixav took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
Wendel Yurboixav was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Wendel Yurboixav did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
